build_select_pytree: build a selection from a JAX PyTree to enable functional subtree manipulation and modification
refactor_selection_apply: refactor a Selection by applying a function to each selected subtree with optional keypath access
test_selection_where: test a Selection by filtering selected nodes with a predicate function and optional keypath
create_selection_at_instances_of: create a refined Selection that selects all subtrees matching a given Python type
summarize_selection_partition: summarize a Selection by partitioning the tree into selected and remainder parts with sentinel markers
